p2aDefect.behavior: GATE_ROOT = env(PALIMPSEST_P2A_GATE_ROOT) ?? ~/.palimpsest-gates; RIG = join(GATE_ROOT, 'p2a-level-c'); rmSync(RIG, {recursive:true, force:true})
risks: a caller-controllable root could point at a user directory
a fixed name collides across parallel runs
no containment proof before a recursive delete

correctedBehavior.containmentProof: realpathSync both root and gate root; assert the relative path is non-empty and does not escape
correctedBehavior.reparseRefusal: lstatSync(root).isSymbolicLink() — a junction/symlink target is never deleted
correctedBehavior.cleanup: delete ONLY the created directory, with bounded async retries (Windows releases SQLite/git handles after close); on persistent failure the directory is PRESERVED and the reason reported
correctedBehavior.parallelSafety: unique per-run names mean concurrent gate executions cannot corrupt each other's artifacts
